# Databricks notebook source
# COMMAND ----------
df = spark.read.csv("/Volumes/workspace/mlpab97d2fb/leakage_vol/training_data.csv", header=True, inferSchema=True)
df.createOrReplaceTempView("training_data")
print(f"Row count: {df.count()}")
df.printSchema()

# COMMAND ----------
# Compute correlation of each feature with the label
from pyspark.sql.functions import col, abs as spark_abs, corr, when, count

features = ["f1", "f2", "f3", "f4", "f5", "f6"]
print("Pearson correlations with label:")
for feat in features:
    c = df.select(corr(col(feat), col("label").cast("double"))).collect()[0][0]
    print(f"  {feat}: {c:.6f}  (abs: {abs(c):.6f})")

# COMMAND ----------
# Check point-biserial correlation proxy and mutual information via a simple SQL groupby
# For each feature, check mean values per label class
print("\nMean values per label class:")
for feat in features:
    stats = df.groupBy("label").agg({"{}".format(feat): "mean"}).collect()
    vals = {row["label"]: row["avg({})".format(feat)] for row in stats}
    diff = abs(vals.get(1, 0) - vals.get(0, 0))
    print(f"  {feat}: label=0 mean={vals.get(0,0):.4f}, label=1 mean={vals.get(1,0):.4f}, diff={diff:.4f}")

# COMMAND ----------
# Fit a simple logistic regression per feature to get individual AUC
from pyspark.ml.feature import VectorAssembler
from pyspark.ml.classification import LogisticRegression
from pyspark.ml.evaluation import BinaryClassificationEvaluator
from pyspark.sql.functions import col

evaluator = BinaryClassificationEvaluator(labelCol="label", metricName="areaUnderROC")

print("\nPer-feature AUC (logistic regression, single feature):")
results = {}
for feat in features:
    assembler = VectorAssembler(inputCols=[feat], outputCol="features")
    assembled = assembler.transform(df)
    lr = LogisticRegression(featuresCol="features", labelCol="label")
    model = lr.fit(assembled)
    preds = model.transform(assembled)
    auc = evaluator.evaluate(preds)
    results[feat] = auc
    print(f"  {feat}: AUC={auc:.6f}")

# COMMAND ----------
# Find the leaking feature (highest AUC)
leaking = max(results, key=results.get)
print(f"\nLeaking feature (highest AUC): {leaking} with AUC={results[leaking]:.6f}")

# Save result to volume
result_json = '{{"feature": "{}"}}'.format(leaking)
spark.createDataFrame([{"result": result_json}]).write.mode("overwrite").text("/Volumes/workspace/mlpab97d2fb/leakage_vol/result")
print("Result saved:", result_json)
NOTEBOOK_EOF
echo "Script created"

# Databricks notebook source
# COMMAND ----------
df = spark.read.csv("/Volumes/workspace/mlpab97d2fb/leakage_vol/training_data.csv", header=True, inferSchema=True)
df.createOrReplaceTempView("training_data")
print(f"Row count: {df.count()}")

# COMMAND ----------
# Compute Pearson correlations with label using SQL
result = spark.sql("""
SELECT
  corr(f1, label) as corr_f1,
  corr(f2, label) as corr_f2,
  corr(f3, label) as corr_f3,
  corr(f4, label) as corr_f4,
  corr(f5, label) as corr_f5,
  corr(f6, label) as corr_f6
FROM training_data
""")
result.show()

row = result.collect()[0]
corrs = {
  "f1": abs(row["corr_f1"]),
  "f2": abs(row["corr_f2"]),
  "f3": abs(row["corr_f3"]),
  "f4": abs(row["corr_f4"]),
  "f5": abs(row["corr_f5"]),
  "f6": abs(row["corr_f6"])
}
print("Absolute correlations:", corrs)
leaking = max(corrs, key=corrs.get)
print(f"Leaking feature: {leaking} with |corr|={corrs[leaking]:.6f}")

# COMMAND ----------
# Also check mean per class
spark.sql("""
SELECT label,
  avg(f1) as avg_f1, avg(f2) as avg_f2, avg(f3) as avg_f3,
  avg(f4) as avg_f4, avg(f5) as avg_f5, avg(f6) as avg_f6
FROM training_data
GROUP BY label ORDER BY label
""").show()

# COMMAND ----------
# Save result
import json
evidence = {f: float(v) for f, v in corrs.items()}
result_obj = {"feature": leaking, "evidence": evidence}
result_str = json.dumps(result_obj)
print("Result:", result_str)

spark.sql(f"CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE workspace.mlpab97d2fb.leakage_result AS SELECT '{result_str}' as result")
print("Saved to table workspace.mlpab97d2fb.leakage_result")
